sanskrit: eṣā tvacāṃ puruṣe saṃ babhūva- -anagnāḥ sarve paśavo ye anye | kṣatrenātmānaṃ pari dhāpayetām amotaṃ vāso mukham odanasya ||
english: This one came together as the skin upon the person — all other cattle are without fire. Let the two of them clothe the self with royal power; and that garment shall be the covering, the face of the rice-offering.

sanskrit: yad akṣeṣu vadasi yat samityāṃ yad vā dhane anṛtaṃ vittakāmyā | samānaṃ tantuṃ saha saṃvasānau tasmin sarvaṃ śamalaṃ sādayāthaḥ ||
english: Whatever falsehood you utter in dice, whatever at the assembly, or in competition out of desire for wealth — dwelling together on the same thread, you two shall deposit all that defilement therein.

sanskrit: varṣaṃ vanuṣvāpi gaccha devāṃs tvaco dhūmaṃ pary ut pātayāsi | viśvavyacā viśvakarmā svargaḥ sayonir lokam upa yāhy etam ||
english: Win the rain, go also to the gods; you shall send the smoke of the skin flying upward and around. Heaven, all-encompassing and all-accomplishing, is of one womb — go up to that world.

sanskrit: tanvaḥ svargo bahudhā vi cakre yathā vida ātmany anyavarṇāḥ | apājait kṛṣṇāṃ ruśatīṃ punāno yā lohinī tāṃ te agnau juhomi ||
english: Heaven spread out the body in many ways, so that you may know the different colors within the self. Purifying itself, it has conquered the dark and the bright; that which is red — that I offer for you into the fire.

sanskrit: prācyai diśe agnaye 'dhipataye 'sitāya rakṣitra ādityāyeṣumata etaṃ pari dadhmaḥ | taṃ no gopāyantv āsmākam aitor diṣṭaṃ no atra jarase ni neṣat | jarā mṛtyave pari ṇo dadhātv adhā pakvena saha saṃ bhavema ||
english: To the eastern quarter, to Agni the overlord, to the dark one the guardian, to the Āditya bearing arrows — we wrap this around. May they protect us; may what is fated for us not lead us here to old age. May old age deliver us over to death; then may we come together with what is ripened.

sanskrit: dakṣiṇāyai diśa indrāyādhipataye tiraścirāje rakṣitre vasubhya iṣumadbhya etam (…) ||
english: To the southern quarter, to Indra the overlord, to Tiraścirāja the guardian, to the Vasus bearing arrows — this [we wrap around, with the same protective prayer as in the east].

sanskrit: pratīcyai diśe varuṇāyādhipataye pṛdākave rakṣitre mitrāyeṣumata etam (…) ||
english: To the western quarter, to Varuṇa the overlord, to the serpent Pṛdāku the guardian, to Mitra bearing arrows — this [we wrap around, with the same protective prayer as in the east].

sanskrit: udīcyai diśe somāyādhipataye svajāya rakṣitre vātāyeṣumata etam (…) ||
english: To the northern quarter, to Soma the overlord, to the serpent Svaja the guardian, to Vāta bearing arrows — this [we wrap around, with the same protective prayer as in the east].

sanskrit: dhruvāyai diśe viṣṇave 'dhipataye kalmāṣagrīvāya rakṣitre vīrudbhya iṣumatībhya etam (…) ||
english: To the fixed quarter — the zenith — to Viṣṇu the overlord, to Kalmāṣagrīva the guardian, to the plants bearing arrows — this [we wrap around, with the same protective prayer as in the east].

sanskrit: ūrdhvāyai diśe bṛhaspataye 'dhipataye śvitrāya rakṣitre aśanībhya iṣumatībhya etaṃ pari dadhmaḥ | taṃ no gopāyantv āsmākam aitor diṣṭaṃ no atra jarase ni neṣat | jarā mṛtyave pari ṇo dadhātv athā pakvena saha saṃ bhavema ||
english: To the upper quarter, to Bṛhaspati the overlord, to Śvitra the guardian, to the thunderbolts bearing arrows — we wrap this around. May they protect us; may what is fated for us not lead us here to old age. May old age deliver us over to death; then may we come together with what is ripened.
